# xcsh_artifact_registry_token (Ephemeral Resource)

Authentication credential for access control.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace` (String) Namespace. Namespace is used to scope the query.

### Read-Only

- `expiration_time` (String, Sensitive) Expiration Time. Expiration time of the token.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Access token for the F5 Artifact Registry (FAR) This token can be used to authenticate with FAR when pulling related images for Kubernetes bot infrastructure.
